trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work through the roadmap stages in order, tick each trophy off in this tracker as it pops, and this one follows automatically. The only trophy that can fight back at the end is A Long Road, the 100% completion gold.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the story (Stage 1) and the side strands (Stage 2).
Clear the activities, robberies and collectibles (Stage 3).
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road (Stage 4) — the platinum pops with it.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first story mission of the game, so this is the first trophy most players earn and it cannot be missed — just follow the on-screen prompts until the mission-complete screen appears.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Start a new game and follow the opening mission prompts.
Finish Gone Fishing to the mission-complete screen.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. The chapter ends automatically once its final mission is complete, and the trophy pops with it. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing this guide warns about everywhere: the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude. After the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — when Lucia says she is going to meditate, follow her to the balcony and accept.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through all of Chapter 1's story missions.
After Down to Earth, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. The trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Chapter 2 is also where several systems unlock — the Scooter Bros app (after the mission Moses) and garage buying (after Daily Driver) — so poke at those between missions rather than leaving them all for the post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through all of Chapter 2's story missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter 3 is a good time to start the Sneakthief setup: the mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun you need for a silent jewelry store robbery, so do that mission when it appears rather than skipping it.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through all of Chapter 3's story missions.
Do Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs when it appears (it unlocks the Snap Gun).
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. The trophy pops when the chapter closes. In Chapter 4, look out for the optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which unlocks the large bank vault robberies you need for Maximum Withdrawal — do it when it shows up so the vaults are open for the rest of the game.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play through all of Chapter 4's story missions.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… when it appears.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission, at the end of Chapter 5. The story runs about 60 to 80 hours across five chapters, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and the end of each chapter — the game gives you 15 manual save slots plus one autosave. After the credits, free-roam continues and everything needed for the platinum is still available.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (no mission replay).
Play through Chapter 5 to the final mission and finish it.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story, so just keep playing the campaign and the mission will appear. It cannot be missed as long as you finish the story.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story mission, so it appears as you play through the campaign and cannot be missed. Finish it and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is part of the main campaign, so it shows up as you work through the story and cannot be missed. Finish the mission and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a main-story mission that appears as the campaign progresses, so it cannot be missed. Play it through to the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the story until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is part of the main story at Vice City International Airport, so it appears as you play the campaign and cannot be missed. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main-story mission that appears as the campaign progresses, so it cannot be missed. Play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission to the end.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but anything you did during the story already counts toward it, so chip away as you go. It is the hardest and longest trophy, part of a roughly 200-hour platinum. The checklist asks for every robbery type (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditation spots, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries and 100 flamingos. Note the thresholds are higher than the standalone trophies — the standalone stunt trophy only needs 250, for example — so keep going after each individual trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Finish the story first; progress made during it already counts.
After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list top to bottom.
Clear every robbery type, then the collectibles, then the remaining challenges and stunts.
Check the tracker after each session so nothing is left half-done.

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts mix across four types — Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights and Base Jumps — and any 250 of the 397 in the game count, so pick the types you find easiest instead of grinding one category. Keep going after this pops: 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so the extra 50 are not wasted.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies

steps: Try each stunt type once and find the easiest for you.
Work through Stunt Jumps and Under the Bridges first — they are the most repeatable.
Reach 250 for this trophy, then push on to 300 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. You do not need to win or finish any of them — one attempt at each type is enough. The quickest way is to sample them as you meet them during the story: a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a shooting range session, a drone race and the rest. Tick this off early so you are not hunting for the one activity type you never touched.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: As you explore, try every activity icon you pass at least once.
Check off each type as you try it; nine types in total.
The trophy pops the moment the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Every challenge needs a gold score, not just a pass, so treat this as a skill grind: learn each range's weapon and target pattern, retry the ones you silver, and come back with better weapons or upgrades if a challenge feels out of reach. The ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
Vice City Hustle — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Visit a shooting range and work through its challenges.
Replay any challenge that lands below gold until it hits gold.
Clear all 12 ranges — 42 gold medals in total.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location has its own race, so you need a win at all of them, not 14 wins at one spot. Learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race to win — the drone races stay available after the story, so mop up any locations you skipped.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find a Top Fun Drone Race location and enter the race.
Win the race at that location, then move to the next.
Win at all 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different — winning the same race 20 times does not count. Work through the race list across Leonida, using a fast, well-handling car for road races and the right vehicle for each race type, and tick each new win off as you go.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Enter races across Leonida, a different one each time.
Win 20 distinct races in total.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities you meet early in the game, and Cal is the rival angler who challenges you. Take the challenge, land the better catch, and the trophy pops. If you lose, just challenge him again — there is no penalty for retrying.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go fishing and meet Cal's challenge.
Beat his catch to win the challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game — play one arcade cabinet game all the way to its end. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you enjoy most or find easiest, and finish a full run rather than quitting halfway. Arcades are scattered around Vice City and stay open after the story.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Vice City.
Play one game through to its end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand is a side questline: follow his missions until the last one is done. Andy's missions are Lucia-only, so play them as Lucia when they appear. Quest givers can go quiet for a stretch mid-story, but every trophy-related contact comes back later, so do not worry if Andy disappears for a while.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

steps: Play Andy's missions as Lucia whenever they appear.
Complete the final mission in his strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is a side questline that runs alongside the story. He can become temporarily unavailable during the campaign, but all trophy-related quest givers return later in the game, so keep checking back and finish his missions when they appear.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Kenton's missions as they appear.
Complete the final mission in his strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is a side questline: take his missions as they show up and see the strand through to its last mission. Like the other character strands, it stays available in free-roam after the story, so there is no deadline.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Billy's missions as they appear.
Complete the final mission in his strand.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions are the optional side questlines marked around the map — talk to the strangers you meet and finish their strands. Note that Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's questlines do not count toward this trophy, so count your completed stranger strands in the trophy tracker rather than counting every optional contact. Eight qualifying strands are all you need.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Talk to strangers marked on the map and start their strands.
Finish a strand all the way through — a single mission is not enough.
Complete 8 qualifying strands (Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is a side questline: take his missions as they appear and finish the strand with its last mission. It stays available in free-roam after the story, so work on it whenever it suits you.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Follow Randy's missions as they appear.
Complete the final mission in his strand.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a side questline and his missions are Jason-only, so play them as Jason when they appear. The strand stays available after the story, so there is no deadline — just see it through to its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

steps: Play Tyrone's missions as Jason whenever they appear.
Complete the final mission in his strand.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY IN THE GAME. In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, go to Jason's house in the morning: Lucia will be in the kitchen and say she is going to meditate. Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That meditation raises your counter but is not marked as a spot like the others, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway, because once Chapter 1 ends it is gone for good. The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. For 100% completion only 15 of the 18 spots are needed, so even a missed Chapter 1 meditation cannot cost you the 100% trophy — but it might cost you this one, so do not skip it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements
Mobalytics — GTA 6 Full Trophy List & Walkthrough

steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning, follow her to the balcony and Accept the meditation. Do this before Chapter 1 ends.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when both characters are playable, work through the remaining meditation spots.
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is a hunting questline — Jason-only — and the trophy is about one specific unique animal, not ordinary hunting. Follow Bret's missions until he points you at the unique target, then track and take it down. While you explore, study animals through binoculars too: 100% completion needs 100 of the 255 animals studied, and studying does not require killing them.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements

steps: Play Bret's strand as Jason until he names the unique animal.
Track and hunt that animal.
Study other animals with binoculars along the way (100 studied for 100%).

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets to complete them. Three finished sets are enough for this trophy, but 100% completion asks for 15 complete sets, so keep collecting after this pops. Keep your sets in separate notes so you know which cards you still need.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Finish 3 full sets for this trophy, then keep going to 15 sets for 100% completion.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning feature — point it at locations around Leonida to log them. Work through the map region by region so you do not miss spots, and keep vehicle scanning separate in your notes: scanning vehicles is a different objective from scanning locations. 100% completion also asks for 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and the checklist line up exactly.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Use WAiNK on locations as you travel — sweep region by region.
Reach 100 scanned locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, so 50 is a little over half. Work through the groups you find easiest first, and keep going after this pops: 100% completion needs any 70 of the 80, so the extra 20 are part of the platinum anyway.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Open the challenges list and pick the easiest group first.
Complete 50 challenges, then push on to 70 of 80 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner, build up to four stars, then break line of sight and escape the red heat zone — clearing the flashing search area alone is not enough, you must get out of the heat zone entirely. A handy overlap: large bank vault robberies trigger a 4-star Wanted Level, so work on this during a vault job. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County gives cover from helicopters and makes pursuit harder for police cars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Bring your partner and raise your Wanted Level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and escape the red heat zone completely.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia helps against helicopters.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. This one is the opposite of Hot Together: you must keep the red-and-blue flashing pursuit active between shops. Staying inside the red heat zone without an active Wanted Level does not count. Hit three shops in a row, keep the heat on between them, and the trophy can pop about 30 seconds after you leave the final shop — do not abandon an attempt that looks finished too early.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Bring your partner and rob a shop.
Keep the pursuit active and rob two more shops back-to-back.
Wait ~30 seconds after leaving the third shop for the pop.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. New vehicles count as discovered when you find and scan them, so scan every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you come across instead of walking past it. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Scan every new vehicle you find as you explore.
Reach 100 discovered, then push on to 200 of 277 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. While aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to activate Combat Focus, then drop five enemies before the focus bar runs out. Adrenaline extends the duration, and an assault rifle helps you work through a clustered group of gang enemies before the bar drains. Pick a fight with a big group — a gang hangout or a robbery shootout — rather than trying it on two or three stragglers.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find a clustered group of enemies (a gang hangout works well).
Aim, press L3 + R3 to start Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before the focus bar drains — use Adrenaline to extend it.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. You need a large passenger plane connected to a boarding bridge — the plane at terminals E3/E4 is a good choice — not a plane parked elsewhere on the airfield. Board it, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops after a short delay.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger plane at a boarding bridge (terminals E3/E4).
Board it, climb to the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km from the airport and wait for the pop.

trophies.guide: This trophy is about the Rhino tanks — but the exact trigger has not yet been pinned down in a published guide, so this guide will not invent one. The description points at doing something with Rhinos (the tanks), most likely destroying them or surviving an encounter with them. Check the PowerPyx roadmap for the latest confirmed method before you go hunting tanks, and do not waste time on guesses. Everything else in this guide is sourced; this one is flagged honestly until a source confirms it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Check the PowerPyx guide for the confirmed Rhino method.
The trigger is not yet confirmed in a published guide — do not grind on a guess.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun. Use the Snap Gun on the jewelry store's locked back door, find the safe-code note inside, and open the safe quietly — kicking the door triggers the alarm and ruins the attempt. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a suitable target. Go in quiet, get the goods, and leave without anyone raising the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on the back door of a jewelry store (Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds works).
Find the safe-code note inside, open the safe quietly, and leave undetected.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Large bank vault robberies unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow the security van to a bank and enter while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash bags alone. Each robbery triggers a 4-star Wanted Level, which also feeds Hot Together. Five vaults earn this trophy, but 100% completion needs all eight, so keep robbing after it pops.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock large vault robberies.
Bring your partner, follow a security van to a bank, and enter while the guard has the vault open.
Rob the vault and escape — 5 times for this trophy, 8 for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash, and then escape — clearing the flashing search area is not enough, you must get out of the red heat zone as well. Plan your escape route before you hit the truck, and use quiet roads or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia to break the pursuit.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Find an armored truck and stop it.
Take the cash, then escape the red heat zone completely.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit all 52 areas of the state. The trophy is about coverage, not speed: drive, fly and sail into every named area until the map is filled in. Work region by region, and combine it with the other exploration trophies (WAiNK scans, vehicle discoveries, stunt spots) so one trip counts for several trackers at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Travel region by region across Leonida.
Visit all 52 areas — combine the trip with WAiNK scans and vehicle discoveries.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough for this trophy, but 100% completion needs all 39 operations, so this is really a down-payment on the checklist. Work through the gangs one at a time and keep a note of which gangs you have hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Find an Illegal Operation for one gang and rob it.
Repeat for all 9 gangs, then keep going to all 39 operations for 100% completion.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the Ocean Beach waterfront in Vice City, find a bar or beach spot with a view of the ocean, and order a cocktail. The trophy is a quiet moment rather than a challenge — take the drink, take in the view, and it pops. A nice one to do early, while you are exploring the beach anyway.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a bar spot with an ocean view and order a cocktail.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's front window, the way the series' most famous moments do it. The exact showroom has not yet been pinned down in a published guide, so this guide will not name one on a guess: try a large dealership showroom with a car inside, build speed, and smash out through the glass. Check the PowerPyx roadmap for a confirmed showroom before you spend long on it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Take a car into a large vehicle showroom.
Drive out through the front in classic style — check PowerPyx for the confirmed showroom.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn. This is not a game of bowling: it is a robbery. Steal the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the contents of the safe in the northeast hallway office. Bring Sticky Bombs for the safe, then escape the police. Valuables you already collected still count if you return during a later robbery, so a second visit finishes anything you missed.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (bring Sticky Bombs).
Steal the luxury watch (southeast office) and the shotgun (northeast table).
Blow the safe in the northeast hallway office, take its contents, and escape the police.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia. Visit fitness clubs and train — and visit them together, so the inactive partner trains alongside the character you control. It is a slow stat grind rather than a single event, so fold gym sessions into your routine between missions instead of leaving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Visit fitness clubs regularly with both characters.
Train Strength with Jason and Lucia until both hit maximum — go together so both train at once.

trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your Criminal Profile. Robberies, enemy encounters and other criminal actions all contribute, so this builds up naturally as you play — leave it until other jobs are finished, and a separate grind is probably unnecessary. Check your profile counter in the Progress menu now and then; if you are close after everything else is done, a few extra robberies will close the gap.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters feed your Criminal Profile.
Leave this until late; top up with extra robberies if the counter is short at the end.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try. The name says it: fail something, then succeed at the same thing on your next attempt. The exact trigger has not yet been confirmed in a published guide, so this guide will not invent a specific activity for it — most likely a retry of a failed mission, race or challenge that you then pass. Play normally and retry your failures instead of reloading old saves, and check the PowerPyx guide for a confirmed trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: If you fail a mission, race or challenge, retry it instead of reloading an old save.
Succeed on the second attempt — check PowerPyx for the confirmed trigger.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange. The description is deliberately vague, and the exact event has not yet been confirmed in a published guide — it is most likely one of the game's paranormal or UFO-style encounters, the kind of oddity you stumble on while exploring Leonida. Explore the stranger corners of the map, especially at night, and check the PowerPyx guide for the confirmed location once it is published. This guide flags it honestly rather than inventing a spot.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Explore Leonida's stranger corners, especially at night.
Check PowerPyx for the confirmed encounter once it is published.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a person with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Get a melee weapon equipped, drive past a pedestrian at speed, and swing as you pass. It takes a little timing, so pick a quiet road with pedestrians around and line the pass up before you swing.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Equip a melee weapon and get in a vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and swing the melee weapon as you pass.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and other criminal work; launder them through your contacts to turn them into clean money. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so just keep laundering as you earn — by the time you have finished the robbery trophies, this should be close or done.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies and criminal work.
Launder them through your contacts — $250,000 in total, cumulative.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative, and every shop counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, whatever you buy. Spend naturally through the game and this will land on its own; if you are short at the end, buy ammo and car upgrades, which are useful anyway. Save the $160,000 for the eight garages first, though — Little Boxes is a separate trophy and you do not want to be broke for it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

steps: Spend across shops as you play — clothes, weapons, food, car mods all count.
Reserve $160,000 for the eight garages first, then top up to $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all eight purchasable garages. The four story garages do not count, so you need the eight you buy yourself, $160,000 in total. Garage purchases open through the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Reserve the money before spending freely on clothes or tattoos, then buy all eight.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver to unlock garage buying in the Vice City Real Estate app.
Save $160,000, then buy all 8 purchasable garages (story garages do not count).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app unlocks through the Chapter 2 mission Moses. Take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. Cheap cars and bikes keep registration costs down. At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; later Chapter 3 progress permits Standard Tracker vehicles and registration at Pay 'n' Spray locations. The extra garage space from Little Boxes helps, since you need room to hold the vehicles you register.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Take cheap stolen cars or bikes to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray, then Register — 10 vehicles in total.
